ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 70% high-intensity (white) pixels on the lateral lobes and 30% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated centrally and along trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, contiguous white geometric blobs occupy the primary surface of both lateral lobes. A central low-intensity region surrounds the notch, featuring irregular stippled margins and dark banding along the trailing edge margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; approximate pixel angle of 45 degrees with a significant vertical depth relative to the horizontal fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration across the entire trailing edge boundary; peaks and valleys are most pronounced on the distal portions of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading edges exhibit a convex mathematical sweep; trailing edges follow a generally linear path from tip to notch with significant micro-level pixel variations.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch/indentation is visible on the upper trailing edge of the left lobe, diverging from the surrounding serration pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique stippling and mottled pixel distribution at the interface of the central black pigment and the white lateral fields.
